palette: deep walnut brown ground + cream panel plaques + indigo civil-law accents + rust common-law accents + brass hairlines + oxblood seals
typography: ink headings on cream plaques, walnut label tabs with brass left bar, indigo reserved for the civil-law side, rust reserved for the common-law side, oxblood seals for rulings, thin ink underlines
composition: the definition hangs as a hall plaque above three family gateways; the two great families face each other as twin crest plates with alias scrolls; five macro differences cross the hall as paired comparison lanes; degree footnotes close as two side plates with exam chips
surface: flat deep walnut brown with faint brass graining hairlines, cream panels with hairline borders, no gradients, no rounded cards, no drop shadows
motion: panels slide in from the paired halls, crest plates tip toward each other once, comparison lanes draw across left then right, seals stamp once
transition: a velvet wipe draws the previous panel off the hall floor
